initial_condition_scope: Existing truncated control: density on 7<r<13, velocity samples below3 Gaussian scales. No tail extension.
sampling: Every positive density bin and finite centered21-cell logarithmic slope. Heavy segments have effective marker count at least 32. All density bins in each slope window are positive.
time_scope: Constant-rate physical clock. Every plotted profile is an actual saved state. Each slot uses the latest preceding profile; the final actual accepted profile has one final slot. No density interpolation or extended final hold.
final_slot_scope: A final off-grid accepted profile occupies one frame. Its actual final physical interval can be shorter than the nominal playback step; this one bounded endpoint slot retains the final data.
ordinate_display: Density outside [10^-15,10^1] and slopes outside [-10,5] lie outside the visible ordinates. All source values and masks are retained.

slope_reference_guides.numeric_labels: One point above each line. Right-aligned at x=.97 for -3/-1 and x=.90 for -1.5 to separate labels.
